rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Business Identity Takeover")`
`comment("Detects clustered signer, address, and banking detail changes on established commercial accounts")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:commercial_account_management
  (account_type="commercial" OR account_type="business_checking"
   OR account_type="business_savings" OR account_type="commercial_line_of_credit")
| eval account_age_months = round((now() - strptime(account_open_date, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 2592000)
| where account_age_months >= 12
| eval change_category = case(
    modification_type IN ("authorized_signer_add", "authorized_signer_remove", "authorized_signer_change"), "signer",
    modification_type IN ("business_address_change", "mailing_address_change", "registered_address_change"), "address",
    modification_type IN ("routing_number_change", "wire_instruction_change", "beneficiary_change", "account_link_change"), "banking_detail",
    1=1, "other")
| where change_category IN ("signer", "address", "banking_detail")
| stats dc(change_category) AS change_types
    min(_time) AS first_change max(_time) AS last_change
    values(modification_type) AS all_modifications
    values(modified_by_user) AS modifying_users
    values(modification_channel) AS channels
    BY account_id, business_name, tax_id
| eval window_days = round((last_change - first_change) / 86400)
| where change_types >= 3 AND window_days <= 14
| eval risk_score = case(
    window_days <= 3 AND isnotnull(mvfind(channels, "online|api")), "critical",
    window_days <= 7, "high",
    1=1, "high")
| table account_id, business_name, tax_id, change_types, window_days,
        all_modifications, modifying_users, channels, risk_score
| sort - risk_score window_days
rules.title: DL-0165: Business Identity Takeover — Rapid Signer, Address, and Banking Detail Changes on Established Account (SPLUNK)
